title: The 2003 Human Genome Project sequence covered over 90 percent
summary: NHGRI says the 2003 sequence accounted for over 90 percent, not a gapless genome.
body: The National Human Genome Research Institute's Human Genome Project fact sheet says the project's signature goal was the first sequence of the human genome, that in 2001 a draft was announced, and that in 2003 the project produced a sequence accounting for over 90 percent of the human genome, as complete as the technology then allowed. The v1 line "2003: Human Genome Project completed" overstates a draft that the institute itself describes as over 90 percent. A later telomere-to-telomere sequence is a different paper.
